notes.title: Localization Update is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!

A new patch is avaliable now. Read the details below and let us know what you think in the comments.

Patch Notes for v1.0.4s0
	- Localization - Game now supports 
		○ Japanese
		○ Brazilian Portuguese
		○ Simplified Chinese
		○ Russian
	- Tons of fixes to various UI elements to better support high-res fonts. 
	- Fixed dialogue showing out-of-order in some instances or not saving properly.
	- Adjusted animation speeds of a few pickups.
	- The [spoiler] Rob the Bank [/spoiler] quest no longer progresses when [spoiler]viewing the Rigsby Boss intro [/spoiler].
